summary: The US has completed its 11th consecutive night of strikes against Iran, targeting military operations centers, maritime capabilities, and logistics infrastructure. The Lebanese army deployed in Zawtar al-Gharbiya after Israeli forces withdrew from the area. A senior Hamas commander responsible for the October 7 attack and hostage operations was killed in an IDF airstrike in Gaza City. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5459) (Source: @manniefabian/58819) (Source: @manniefabian/58818)
key_points: The US completed its 11th consecutive night of strikes against Iran, targeting military operations centers, maritime capabilities, aircraft hangars, drone storage, and logistics infrastructure. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5459)
The Lebanese army began deploying in Zawtar al-Gharbiya after Israeli forces withdrew from the area as part of a framework agreement. (Source: @manniefabian/58819)
A senior Hamas commander who oversaw the October 7 attack and held hostages was killed in an IDF airstrike in Gaza City. (Source: @manniefabian/58818)
Iranian forces targeted US ammunition depots and logistics equipment at Doha Camp in Kuwait with drone attacks. (Source: @naya_foriraq/84777)
Israeli forces opened fire near Lebanese army troops during their deployment in Zawtar al-Gharbiya, with no reported injuries. (Source: @manniefabian/58820)
Iranian air defenses were activated in Tehran and other regions amid ongoing US strikes. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/379784)
The Lebanese army reported 85 alerts on Tuesday, including 75 drones detected and 10 artillery strikes. (Source: @redlinkleb/32381)
Iranian forces targeted US military infrastructure in Kuwait, including Doha Camp, with drone attacks. (Source: @naya_foriraq/84777)

sections.threat_assessment: The US-Iran conflict remains active with sustained strikes on Iranian military infrastructure, including logistics and maritime capabilities. Iranian retaliation has targeted US bases in Kuwait, escalating regional tensions. The Lebanese-Israeli dynamic is volatile, with cross-border incidents and military deployments. Hamas continues to face targeted operations, but its leadership structure may persist. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5459) (Source: @naya_foriraq/84777) (Source: @manniefabian/58820)
sections.regional_response: The Lebanese army's deployment in Zawtar al-Gharbiya signals adherence to the framework agreement with Israel, though tensions persist. Iran's targeting of US infrastructure in Kuwait reflects escalatory measures. Regional actors like France and the UK are monitoring developments, with no immediate escalation beyond current strikes. (Source: @manniefabian/58819) (Source: @naya_foriraq/84777) (Source: @asafroz/51752)
sections.intelligence_notes: US strikes on Iran have focused on degrading military capabilities, particularly in maritime and logistics sectors. Iranian air defenses remain active, suggesting preparedness for further incursions. The Lebanese army's deployment in southern Lebanon indicates a potential de-escalation phase, though cross-border incidents persist. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5459) (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/379784) (Source: @manniefabian/58819)
